Thus for \(k=3\), the condition is
\[
1001001N\equiv 0 \pmod{2019}
\]
Divide by \(3\):
\[
333667N\equiv 0 \pmod{673}.
\]
Since \(\gcd(333667,673)=1\), we need \(N\equiv 0\pmod{673}\). The only 3-digit multiple of \(673\) is \(673\).

So the block is \(abc=673\), giving the number
\[
673673673.
\]
